# Snel Remodeling Services

> Professional painting, remodeling, and drywall contractor serving Salt Lake City and surrounding areas in Utah. Licensed and insured.

## About
Snel Remodeling Services is a licensed and insured residential contractor based in Salt Lake City, Utah. Specializing in interior and exterior painting, kitchen and bathroom remodeling, drywall installation and repair, water damage restoration, and demolition services. Known for quality craftsmanship, clear communication, and fair pricing.

## Services
- Interior painting — walls, ceilings, trim, cabinets
- Exterior painting — siding, trim, fences, decks
- Kitchen remodeling — full renovations, cabinet painting
- Bathroom remodeling — tile, fixtures, full remodels
- Basement finishing and remodeling
- Bedroom and flooring updates
- Drywall installation, repair, and finishing
- Water damage restoration and repair
- Selective demolition and site preparation

## Service Area
Salt Lake City, Sandy, Draper, Murray, West Jordan, South Jordan, Herriman, Riverton, Taylorsville, Millcreek, Holladay, Cottonwood Heights, Bountiful, Utah
